name: Peter Whitmer Jr.
role: Eight Witness and missionary to the Lamanites
dateNote: He was baptized in Seneca Lake in June 1829 and left on the western mission in October 1830.
importance: A young tailor on his father’s Fayette farm, he asked his duty while the translation was finished there. Section 16 answers him in the same words as section 15 to his brother John. He was one of the Eight Witnesses and one of six original members in April 1830. Sections 30 and 32 send him with Oliver Cowdery to preach to the Lamanites on the Missouri border.
connections: Son of Peter Whitmer Sr. and Mary Musselman, and brother of David and John Whitmer. He married Vashti Higley in 1832 and died near Liberty, Missouri.

sources.title: Peter Whitmer Jr., Joseph Smith Papers

reviewNote: Birth (27 September 1809), death (22 September 1836 near Liberty), baptism, witness, mission, and marriage checked on JSP. Sections 16 and 30 address him only as “Peter”, which is too ambiguous to link.
